correctness.rationale: For d>=2 and real trace-free symmetric H, uniform spherical moments through degree eight follow from Gaussian radial decomposition. Sharp inequalities v^TH²v<=((d−1)/d)|v|²T and tr(H⁴)<=((d²−3d+3)/(d(d−1)))T² are simultaneously realized by zonal H and aligned v (d=2 angular degeneracy). Maximization of r²[A_d s²+B_d r s(1−s)+C_d r²(1−s)²] over s∈[0,1] yields threshold r0=2A/B, explicit interior share and norm; coefficient monotonicity gives unique contractivity boundary and Gaussian limit. Independent exact-rational moment calculations confirmed A,B,C at d=2,3,4,7,12. Finite d examples only corroborate, not prove all d.
